name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders and kitchen for a food truck
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, protect the kitchen from overload and keep working when the signal drops. An app for the staff of a food truck.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your crew runs the shift with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order as ready and collected.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how much time it needs. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches what the kitchen can do.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as the orders placed ahead, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs making now, what’s next and what’s ready, with a notification when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP WORKING WHEN THE SIGNAL DROPS
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection drops, orders ahead pause, so nobody sends an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync when you’re online again.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during the shift, get a notification when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is meant for food truck owners and their staff. To sign in, you need a HatchGrab account.
